existing_features.title: Update the profile dropdown menu to remove the separate modal-based "Edit Profile" flow and instead route all profile actions through the single /profile page.

Ensure the /profile page supports both viewing and editing within the same page, including an option to land directly in edit mode when navigated from the profile dropdown (e.g., via a URL query parameter like ?edit=1).
Align user-facing labels in the profile dropdown to reflect the unified experience (e.g., rename the action to "My Profile" or "Profile") and keep all user-facing text in English.

new_feature_requests.summary: Condense/merge the View Profile and Edit Profile screens into a single unified profile page

projectName: Condense View Profile and Edit Profile into a single unified Profile page flow
